prompt: add a Settlement context to velocity. Purpose: once a ride is priced we charge the rider through their payment method so every ride eventually gets paid. UL: Settlement = the process of collecting money for one priced ride; Charge Attempt = one try to take money from the rider's payment method; Outstanding Debt = unpaid amount left after all attempts fail. Inbound: Ride Priced event from Pricing. Outbound: Charge Rider command to Payments, Debt Recorded event to DebtRecovery. Rule: if a charge fails we retry a few times shortly after the ride, then record debt. We're conformist to Payments so skip the ACL there and just use their API directly.
